prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up photograph of a cork bulletin board, with a single white, square sheet of paper pinned at the center using a metallic pushpin. The paper is handwritten in French with black ink, featuring a numbered list and several lines of text, some underlined for emphasis. The handwriting is slightly slanted and casual, giving a personal, informal touch. Around the main note, partially visible black-and-white photographs are pinned to the board, showing minimalist architectural interiors and abstract forms, but these are out of focus, drawing attention to the central note. The color palette is muted and natural, dominated by the warm, textured brown of the cork and the soft white of the paper. Lighting is soft and even, with no harsh shadows, creating a calm, contemplative atmosphere. The camera angle is straight-on, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the background images, emphasizing the handwritten note as the focal point. The overall style is documentary and realistic, evoking the feeling of a personal workspace or an artist’s studio, with a sense of quiet focus and introspection.
